remarks: Welcome to Cranbury-one of Norwalk's most peaceful and convenient neighborhoods. Set on a spacious 0.61-acre lot, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath ranch blends comfort, updates, and a location that makes daily life easy. Inside, you'll find a freshly painted interior with updated lighting and newly refinished hardwood floors. The living room is bright and welcoming, with a large, new picture window filling the space with natural light. The family room opens to a brand new deck through a new sliding glass door-offering the perfect spot to relax, entertain, or watch the seasons change. The kitchen features new stainless steel appliances, refreshed cabinetry, and updated hardware. Both bathrooms have been thoughtfully renovated with new vanities, lighting, and toilets, creating a clean and stylish feel throughout the home. Behind the scenes, almost every outlet, light switch, and fixture has been replaced. The two-car garage offers plenty of storage, and the large lower level provides space with great potential for finishing. Outside, the landscaping has been updated with new grass, trimmed shrubs and trees, and thoughtful touches that give the property a fresh appearance. The backyard is private and peaceful, offering plenty of room to play, garden, or simply enjoy the outdoors. Conveniently located near Stop & Shop, LA Fitness, Walmart, the Norwalk River Trail and minutes to the Merritt Parkway and the connector-this home checks all the boxes for comfort, space, and easy living.
